implementation_overlay: Pre-existing 50 GiB guard-default working-tree changes are retained; exact file hashes below bind execution.
retry_reason: The general evaluation has eight arms, so the actual total is 426 answers rather than 420. The budget is corrected to 426 answers and 2556 tokens. No acceptance rule, model, data or training is changed or repeated.

parent_controls.content: parent_retention/adversarial and parent_retention_dev/adversarial rows from the accepted shared M3 parent

purpose: Independently score the preserved M4 evaluation with the pinned parent adversarial control and run conditional fresh-process restart without retraining. Qualify additive pattern utility, collisions, noninterference, sparse optimizer behavior and restart without treating static tables as editable episodes.
hypothesis: The deterministic router can preserve delayed fast-memory behavior while using static patterns for covered/general queries, reducing fast-residual interference without changing the frozen fast modules.
parent_role: Accepted shared M3 candidate only. The rejected M3 retention-repair candidate is not a parent. A validated additive-pattern migration initializes only the new branch and preserves every old tensor.

dataset.role: Only the 24 delayed_training rows trained pattern tables. Development, regression and exposed diagnostic holdouts never trained or selected thresholds. General replay is evaluation-only in M4.

pattern.ownership: Static learned tables frozen within an accepted extension; editable episodic records and SGDN-2 state remain separate.
pattern.hashing: Deterministic multi-head causal n-gram hashes using signed-int64-safe modular arithmetic; positions before an order is complete are masked.
pattern.context: Known input IDs at each prediction position, including teacher-forced prefixes only when causal. Future tokens never affect earlier lookups.
pattern.residual: Early residual after complete native block 2 with contextual sigmoid gates, RMS normalization and zero-initialized final output projection.

training.feature_producer: Frozen native input-token embeddings and native hidden states; original backbone and all fast-memory parameters remain frozen.
training.write_schedule: Pattern tables train on delayed query/action loss only. Static tables are not updated by new observations at inference; fast state handles episodes and corrections.
training.optimizer: muon8bit with auxiliary FP32 AdamW for nn.Embedding tables. Sparse gradients are densified only for AdamW; Muon rejects sparse gradients.
training.loss: Response-only next-token cross entropy on answer plus EOS; prompt prefix masked. Store loss_sum and true mean_loss.
training.selection: Empty record bank; deterministic pattern/fast/router comparison only.
training.retention_replay: No general replay training in M4. General evaluation is diagnostic-only and not a replay-repair experiment.

evaluation.adversarial_observation:
The deploy region for project Alder is cobalt.
The owner of project Alder is person01.
The launch code for project Alder is teal.
evaluation.router: Eligible exact evidence first, editable fast state for corrections, verified procedures when eligible, then typed pattern/fast routing. Delayed uses pattern only when all query hashes are covered; general queries prefer static patterns.
evaluation.metric: Exact stripped answer by split, stratum, case role and control arm; raw token IDs, route, known/total hash coverage and parent/candidate pairs retained.
evaluation.correction: All twenty delayed corrections require changed state, stale-answer rejection and independently correct corrected answers.
evaluation.collisions: Record lookups, unique indices, collisions/rate, table rows, touched bytes, cold/warm lookup latency and upper-bound dense-gradient materialization.
evaluation.same_process_restart: Save and reload the shared depth image and pattern-bearing extension with stable component versions and exact lineage; do not re-encode observations.
evaluation.fresh_process_restart: If accepted, run_m4_restart.py reloads the extension, pattern table, trained hash inventory and image in a new process and reproduces the routed answer.

decision_rule.router_accept: Router held-out > linear, shuffled, zero and disabled; router held-out >= parent fast and original regression >= parent fast; development >= disabled; final/development adversarial >= parent and final adversarial >= disabled.
decision_rule.engineering_accept: Disabled-base outputs token-identical, fast modules unchanged, post-open gradients finite/nonzero, sparse optimizer step, correction and authenticated reload checks pass.
decision_rule.reject: Any capability, noninterference or engineering gate fails. M4 acceptance is diagnostic_only and does not assert retention repair or Engram-paper equivalence.
decision_rule.defer: Control-ambiguous, lineage, restart or resource failure.
decision_rule.no_promotion: Exposed synthetic diagnostic only; no broad retention, general reasoning, RSI, production routing or learned-router claim.

stop_conditions: wall-time, token, generation or artifact budget exceeded
dataset, parent, protocol or implementation hash mismatch
unauthenticated image/lineage or stale pattern/candidate restart
retention: Keep parent and candidate extensions, pattern/table versions, depth image, raw answers/routes, collisions, optimizer audits, failures and guard traces. No base copy, download, remote push or default publication.
claims: M4 static pattern and deterministic-routing diagnostic on exposed synthetic splits. No retention-repair, broad capability, Engram-paper reproduction, learned router or production deployment claim.
